general.circuito_firma_habilita_siguiente_paso: Allows the next signer to proceed
general.circuito_firma_habilita_envio_notificaci: Allows the notification to be sent
general.circuito_firma_habilita_envio_comunicaci: Allows the communication to be sent
general.circuito_firma_devolucion_vuelve_a_redac: If returned, goes back to drafting
general.circuito_firma_devolucion_vuelve_paso_an: If returned, goes back to the previous step
general.circuito_firma_sin_eficacia: Test signature with no administrative effect
general.circuito_firma_portafirmas_detalle: What is needed for official signing
general.circuito_firma_envio_bloqueado: Not available until IT connects VEC to Firmadoc. Until then nothing is sent and no document counts as officially signed.
general.circuito_firma_portafirmas_sin_envio: No recorded submission or official signature in VEC.
general.circuito_firma_portafirmas_estado_no_dis: The signing workflow cannot be retrieved.
general.circuito_firma_consulta_denegada: You are not authorised to view the signatures for this case.
general.circuito_firma_consulta_no_disponible: The signature status is unavailable. Please try again.
general.circuito_firma_autofirma_prueba: GrxFirma or AutoFirma · TEST with no administrative effect
general.circuito_firma_firmar: Sign with a certificate in VEC
general.circuito_firma_externa_bloqueada: This signature cannot be recorded yet. VEC must identify the authorised original and confirm permission for this step.
general.circuito_firma_externa_fecha: Declared Portafirmas date and time, in local time (required)
general.circuito_firma_externa_advertencia: VEC will verify the PDF. The reference and date are supplied by HR; this record does not prove submission or administrative effect.
general.circuito_firma_externa_resumen: The file {archivo} will be recorded with reference {referencia} and date {fecha} as declared by HR. VEC will check the signature against the authorised original.
general.circuito_firma_externa_revisada: Review the details and confirm the record if they are correct.
general.circuito_firma_externa_datos_invalidos: Select a PDF up to 1 MB and enter the Portafirmas reference and date to continue.
general.circuito_firma_externa_datos_modificados: A detail has changed since review. Select ‘Review record’ again before confirming.
general.circuito_firma_externa_error_datos: The signature was not recorded. Check the PDF, reference and date, then try again.
general.circuito_firma_externa_error_denegado: You are not authorised to record this signature. Contact the person responsible for the case.
general.circuito_firma_externa_registrada: PDF verified and recorded under receipt {recibo}. The Portafirmas reference and date remain HR declarations; administrative effect has not been established.
general.circuito_firma_externa_repetida: This record already exists under receipt {recibo}. No duplicate was created.
general.circuito_firma_motivo_invalido: Enter a reason of 3 to 500 characters.
general.circuito_firma_abriendo_autofirma: Opening your signing program (GrxFirma or AutoFirma): sign the document in that window.
general.circuito_firma_registrada: Signature verified and recorded under receipt {recibo}. It has no administrative effect until processed by the corporate signing platform.
general.circuito_firma_error_verificacion: Signature verification is not enabled on this server, so the signature was not recorded.
general.circuito_firma_error_validador_no_dispon: The verification could not be completed. The signature was not recorded. Please try again later or contact IT support.
general.circuito_firma_error_no_verificada: The signature could not be verified. It was not recorded; try again or contact IT support.
general.circuito_firma_error_autofirma: Could not connect to your signing program (GrxFirma or AutoFirma). Check that it is installed and try again.
general.circuito_firma_error_cancelada: Signing was cancelled in GrxFirma or AutoFirma.
general.circuito_firma_error_fallida: GrxFirma or AutoFirma could not sign the document.
general.circuito_firma_error_cambiado: The case or signing workflow has changed. Reload the case.
general.circuito_firma_error_cadena: The draft does not match the one signed in the previous step; it must be returned for redrafting.
general.circuito_firma_error_denegado: You are not authorised to sign this document.
general.circuito_firma_error_generico: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
